description: What JPA and Hibernate read from a project's own Java besides the mapping annotations: which annotations the project declares cannot change how an attribute is mapped.

rules.description: An annotation on an entity attribute changes nothing about its column when the project declares it, its declaration carries only annotations from java.lang.annotation, and no class of the project implements a Hibernate boot extension point. Hibernate reads a project's own annotation only through a meta-annotation on its declaration or through code handed to it at boot, so the column keeps the grade its mapping gives it.
rules.why: ngrinder marks 27 PerfTest fields with its own @Cloneable (@Target, @Retention and @Documented only), and every one of those columns was graded a guess because the JPA lane did not know the name.

extensionPoints.source: hibernate-core 6.6 and 7.1, org/hibernate/integrator/spi/Integrator.java: integrate(Metadata, BootstrapContext, SessionFactoryImplementor) is handed the whole mapping
hibernate-core 6.6 and 7.1, org/hibernate/jpa/boot/spi/IntegratorProvider.java: hands Hibernate the Integrators above through hibernate.integrator_provider
hibernate-core 6.6 and 7.1, org/hibernate/boot/spi/AdditionalMappingContributor.java: contributes mappings at boot
hibernate-core 6.6 and 7.1, org/hibernate/boot/spi/MetadataBuilderFactory.java: builds the MetadataBuilder itself
spring-boot-autoconfigure 3.x, HibernatePropertiesCustomizer.java: customize(Map) sets any Hibernate property, an integrator provider among them

examples.why: ngrinder's marker: declared in the tree, java.lang.annotation only
a meta-annotation imported with its package, or written in full, is still java.lang.annotation's
a Hibernate meta-annotation makes Hibernate run the annotation's binder, which may change the column
an Integrator is handed the whole mapping at boot and may read any annotation
an annotation from a jar: its declaration is not in the tree
Target may be com.lib's, a package imported whole that the rule does not list
